name: Basic Baton
description: Security nightstick, built for bashing.
flavor: It's a bit worse for wear.
summary: Basic Baton is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Baton
description: Security nightstick, built for bashing.
summary: === Security Sector === * In an area close to Dr. Cahn and to a Dr. Manse hologram. * Close to some lockers and a closed-off room full of security gear. * Next to an email terminal in a large room with some toxic spillage and destroyed robots. * In the room with the Surface Elevator. * Two can be found on the lower floor of Storage Unit C, and one on the upper floor.

name: Boom Bait
description: A device that emits a beeping noise to attract enemies, then a damaging detonation.
summary: Boom Bait is a throwable weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Cane Sword
description: A cane containing a hidden blade
summary: Cane Sword is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Carbon Pickaxe
description: Lighter than a normal pickaxe, consuming less stamina when swung.
flavor: These facts are largely irrelevant for the creature on the receiving end.
summary: Carbon Pickaxe is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Cluster Grenade
description: A grenade that contains many individual incendiaries.
summary: Cluster Grenade is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Cluster Rocket
description: A rocket filled with a chaotic cluster of explosive grenades.
summary: Cluster Rocket is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Combat Knife
description: A knife with only one purpose.
flavor: 'No frills, all kills.'
summary: Combat Knife is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Crowbar
description: A solid piece of steel, but not something you could just swing about with one hand.
flavor: Nothing particularly referencey about this.
summary: === Manufacturing West === * Inside Shipping, close to the area with molten liquid, besides a Barrel. * In the Mapping Center, in the area with the 2 Snipers. * In the mines, close to an area with water and lots of Anteverse Wheat. * In the Tram station.

name: Crowbar 2.0
description: An iconic close-quarters heavy weapon that drags enemies towards you.
summary: Crowbar 2.0 is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Deatomizer
description: A hefty laser cannon for sustained firing and an alternate mode for massive output.
flavor: Behold! Science!
summary: The Deatomizer is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It uses laser charge, like the Laser Katana, and must be charged with a Laser Collector before use or after depleting the charge.

name: Desk Leg
description: A leg from a desk.
summary: Desk Leg is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. Given its low damage output and durability, unless there are no other weapons available, the Desk Leg is better utilized in creating other makeshift weapons such as the Makeshift Crossbow or Peccary Club.

name: Electro-Thrower
description: A supercharged electricity-throwing short-range cannon.
summary: Electro-Thrower is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Electron Grenade
description: Stuns enemies for an extended period.
summary: Electron Grenade is a throwable explosive weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Endothermic Hammer
description: A solid maul made of digital gold infused with frozen essence. Has a chance to freeze enemies on hit.
summary: Endothermic Hammer is a blunt weapon in Abiotic Factor. It has a 15% chance to freeze enemies on hit and does 1.2 times more damage to frozen targets.

name: Energy Pistol
description: A battery-charged laser pistol.
summary: Energy Pistol is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Exor Flail
description: A massive flail, made from bits and pieces of other worlds. A blunt weapon with a chance to cause bleeding
summary: Exor Flail is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Exor Spear
description: A spear no human hands have ever touched, present company excluded.
summary: Exor Spear is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Explosive Cartridge
description: Highly explosive ammo built for impact detonation.
summary: Explosive Cartridge is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Explosive Sledge
description: Incredible tech meets incredible heft, with this large sledgehammer that uses Explosive Cartridges as ammunition.
summary: Explosive Sledge is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Flamethrower
description: A high-pressure, lodestone-fueled flame-spewer.
summary: Flamethrower is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Frag Grenade
description: A military-grade fragmentation grenade.
summary: Frag Grenade is an item in Abiotic Factor. It functions like a regular thrown explosive, exploding on contact and causing damage to anything in the explosion area.

name: Grinder
description: A launcher that propels grinder discs at high velocity.
summary: Grinder is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It fires Grinder Discs that are capable of bouncing off walls.

name: Grinder Disc
description: A disc with a very sharp edge.
summary: Grinder Disc is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Gutnic Rifle
description: A thoroughly serviceable assault rifle, with an arcane edge.
summary: Gutnic Rifle is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Hardlight Saber
description: A plasma-fueled, two-handed melee weapon that deals extra damage to shields and is able to deflect most types of projectiles.
flavor: The first Hardlight prototypes emerged inadvertently from Dr. Rosalia Orozco's experiments with ultra-low temperature vacuum fields.
summary: Hardlight Saber is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It can be crafted using materials found in Reactors.

name: Hardlight Sledge
description: A heavy hardlight projection system that creates a dense bludgeoning field. Alternatively it can project a forward-facing barrier to deflect incoming attacks.
summary: Hardlight Sledge is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It can be crafted using materials found in Reactors.

name: Hardlight Spear
description: A firm thrusting weapon, fueled by plasma and light, with a projectile-hurling mechanism for those capable of throwing weaponry.
flavor: Not to put too fine a point on it, Dr. Jager frequently stressed these hardlight experiments were dropping well below the nanometer requirements for simple photonic classification. A more fitting name had not been selected before his untimely demise.
summary: Hardlight Spear is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It can be crafted using materials found in Reactors.

name: Harpoon Spear
description: A hardy maritime spear capable of dragging targets towards you.
flavor: While it may lack inherent efficiency, it more than makes up for it in brutal pragmatism.
summary: Harpoon Spear is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It has a basic stab attack, and a secondary attack. When the left mouse button is pressed, the spear will stab similar to the Welding Spear. When right mouse button is pressed, the barbed end of the spear shoots out at high speed. When the tip of the spear hits an enemy, it will reel the enemy back to the player a short distance.

name: Hypercross Magbow
description: A fast, flat, near-silent and extremely powerful magnetic projectile launcher with dual bolt compartments.
flavor: More railgun than bow, at this point.
summary: Hypercross Magbow is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. Unlike the Makeshift Crossbow, the Hypercross Magbow has a 4x scope attached, and allows the aiming sway to be stabilized, at an ongoing stamina cost, by holding the Sprint button. It also has substantially less trajectory drop than the Makeshift Crossbow. Like the Makeshift Crossbow, its ammunition can often be recovered after being fired.

name: Ice X Rifle
description: A highly experimental sniper rifle, cryogenically retrofitted for hyper-velocity ice projectiles that briefly freeze targets.
summary: Ice X Rifle is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Impact Hammer
description: A hydraulic sledgehammer with a secondary blow on weakened targets.
summary: Impact Hammer is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Industrial Crossbow
description: A robust, reinforced crossbow with short range scope.
summary: Industrial Crossbow is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Keresphere
description: A grenade that causes those within its yield to flee in terror.
flavor: Although the properties of entities and items from Anteverse 39 are still poorly understood, their effects are obvious.
summary: Keresphere is a throwable in Abiotic Factor.

name: Kitchen Knife
description: A blade used in cooking.
summary: Kitchen Knife is a bladed weapon in Abiotic Factor. It takes the appearance of a standard chef's knife and is one of the first weapons a player can find and use, however it's main purpose is for butchering corpses (both organic and inorganic) for meat.

name: Laser Grenade
description: A bouncing display of dazzling lights that may cause extreme harm to anything in their path.
summary: Laser Grenade is a throwable weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Laser Katana
description: A blade that unleashes deadly laser energy when swung.
flavor: Sometimes the only answer is: 'Why not?'
summary: Laser Katana is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It uses laser charge, like the Deatomizer, and must be charged from a Laser Collector before use or after depleting the charge.

name: Laser Pistol
description: A laser-powered sidearm that can also be recharged manually.
summary: Laser Pistol is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It is the upgraded version of the Energy Pistol.

name: Lightning Spear
description: A spear with high electrical discharge, capable of sending bolts of lightning towards additional targets.
summary: Lightning Spear is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Lode Disc
description: A disc from another world, capable of igniting targets, even through armor.
summary: Lode Disc is an item in Abiotic Factor. It deals holy damage to targets.

name: Lode Pistol
description: A break-action coil pistol retro-fitted with Lodestone technology for rapid charging and micro-detonation rounds.
flavor: While not fully understood, the Lodestone's ability to store and release a broad spectrum energy frequencies has myriad pratical applications.
summary: Lode Pistol is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Lodehammer
description: A fire-dealing warhammer enhanced with Lodestone energy transmission technology.
summary: Lodehammer is a single-hand blunt weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Lodespear
description: A fire-spreading spear with amplified lethality of Lodestone technology.
flavor: The Lodestone's ability to recieve and transmit a wide spectra of energy was only recently discovered by GATE researchers.
summary: Lodespear uses battery charge to cause a small explosion around its impact point, damaging enemies and furniture around it. The explosion has a low chance of igniting enemies with "holy" fire for additional damage over time. It can still be used even without charge but will not cause the "holy" fire damage or ignition effect.

name: Lodestone Bolt
description: A bolt with otherworldly properties, capable of igniting targets, even through armor.
summary: Lodestone Bolt is an item in Abiotic Factor. It deals holy damage to targets.

name: Lodestone Crossbow
description: A repeating crossbow crafted from a hybrid of medieval, modern and distinctly otherworldly elements.
flavor: Nothing quite like the Lodestone Crossbow has ever existed in any of the near-infinite universes that your colleagues theorize to exist.
summary: Lodestone Crossbow is a range weapon in Abiotic Factor. In contrast to the earlier crossbows, it can fire multiple bolts before reloading.

name: Magbow
description: A magnetically accelerated crossbow.
flavor: Part bow, part railgun, just watch where you point it.
summary: Magbow is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. Unlike the Makeshift Crossbow, the Magbow has a 4x scope attached, and allows the aiming sway to be stabilized, at an ongoing stamina cost, by holding the Sprint button. It also has substantially less trajectory drop than the Makeshift Crossbow. Like the Makeshift Crossbow, its ammunition can often be recovered after being fired.

name: Magma Skink (Weapon)
description: A change in diet has made this creature’s acidic mucus highly combustible.
summary: Magma Skink (Weapon) is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Makeshift Bolt
description: Ammo for any crossbow.
summary: Makeshift Bolt is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Makeshift Crossbow
description: A scrappy crossbow made from office supplies.
flavor: Functionally, it's perfect. Aesthethically, well...
summary: Makeshift Crossbow is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Makeshift Spear
description: A spear assembled from office and kitchen supplies.
summary: Makeshift Spear is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Manomin Magnum
description: A hefty magnum that has been defaced - or enhanced.
summary: Manomin Magnum is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Megaton Flask

flavor: Duck and cover.
summary: Megaton Flask is a Chemistry item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Montese SMG

name: Mugnade

summary: The Mugnade functions like a regular thrown explosive, exploding after a delay and causing damage to anything in the explosion area.

name: Net Launcher
description: A compact cannon that launches electrified nets at high velocity and over greater distances. Stuns larger beasts than thrown nets and deals some electrical damage.
summary: Net Launcher is an weapon in Abiotic Factor. It allows the player to temporarily immobilize targets of all sizes (this includes human-sized targets).

name: Night Magnum
description: A heavy-hitting magnum revolver lubricated with the black oil of night.
flavor: An often-overlooked quality of unctions from the Night Realm is their capacity to disperse friction from this realm into numberless others.
summary: Night Magnum is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Null Grenade
description: An anti-hardlight grenade that will neutralize most shields, for a period of time.
summary: Null Grenade is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Oar
description: A rickety old oar, somehow heavier than it looks.
summary: A rickety old oar, somehow heavier than it looks.

name: Ornate Daggers
description: A pair of deadly and beautiful daggers for close range engagements.
summary: Ornate Daggers is a bladed weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Ornate Knife
description: A knife that is as ornate and balanced as it is sturdy and delicate.
summary: Ornate Knife is a bladed weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Patois Rifle
description: A burst-fire assault rifle designed to deliver exceptional damage to anything down range.
summary: Patois Rifle is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Peccary Club

summary: Peccary Club is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Penetrator Rocket
description: A rocket that trades explosive power for unmitigated penetration through multiple targets.
summary: Penetrator Rocket is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Pickaxe
description: A massive digging tool, albeit a touch out of date for the circumstances.
summary: === Manufacturing West === * Close to the portal in the small cave that's close to Shipping. * In the mines, close to the green pipe, where one Optic Lens is needed. * In the mines, in an area with a parked truck and some containers. * In the mines, behind one of the buildings (accessible through some vents). * Back in the tutorial area, accessible from a portal in the mines area, close to the green pipe, where one Optic Lens is needed.

name: Pipe Club
description: A hefty pipe with a gauge on the end for added weight.
summary: Pipe Club is a makeshift blunt weapon in Abiotic Factor consisting of a metal pipe with a pressure gauge glued to the end of it. Its wide swing arc makes it ideal for hitting multiple enemies simultaneously or breaking several crates at once.

name: Pipe Cudgel
description: A strong, sturdy pipe, but nothing you haven't seen before.
summary: Pipe Cudgel is a blunt weapon in Abiotic Factor. It is a stronger version of the Pipe Club.

name: Pipe Pistol
description: An electromagnetically charged projectile launcher. It's sort of like a pistol.
summary: Pipe Pistol is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Pipe Wrench
description: A heavy duty wrench.
summary: Pipe Wrench is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Pitchfork
description: A rusty old pitchfork, equally suitable for shoveling hay or rabble-rousing.

summary: Plasma Disc is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Plasma Flail
description: A sphere of hot plasma suspended in an advanced magnet array, swung wildly from a precarious braid of wires and gizmos.
flavor: An absurd weapon for an uncivilized decade.
summary: Plasma Flail is a blunt weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Plasmois Rifle
description: A rifle retooled to ionize projectiles that deal increased damage against bodyshields, with all pre-installed biometric locks now removed.
flavor: GATE's Risk Assessment Committee isn't renowned for being restrictive, but it would have asked some serious questions about this weapon.
summary: Plasmois Rifle is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It fires in a 3-round burst, rather than fully automatic fire, with fairly strong recoil over the 3 shots.

name: Polished Antique Shotgun
description: A break-action double barrel shotgun of a rather old make. ... And something more.
flavor: GATE Immurement Registry: IS-0099
summary: Polished Antique Shotgun is a weapon and anomalous subject in Abiotic Factor.

name: Quantum Pick
description: A throwable pick that returns automatically to the hand.
flavor: Two words: Weaponized entanglement.
summary: Quantum Pick is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Quill Rifle
description: A re-engineered bioweapon, turning Exor quills into deadly homing bolts that stick into targets and coat them with acidic residue.
flavor: If you can't beat them, repurpose them.
summary: Quill Rifle is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Quill Spear
description: A spear based loosely on existing Exor designs, capable of loading and firing a barrage of deadly quills.
summary: Quill Spear is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: REDACTION Grenade
description: Whatever information was available on this device, it's long gone now.
flavor: When you absolutely need to delete all traces of information.
summary: [REDACTION] Grenade is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Rail Rifle
description: A magnetically extended and rechambered hyper-projectile sniper rifle.
flavor: If you can see it, you can probably kill it.
summary: Rail Rifle is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Ramrod
description: A powerful electrical mace with an extended capacitor bank for heavier shocks.
flavor: Some credit for this weapon's enhanced destruction must go to Lionel Simmon's and Varsha Patel's experimental work on supercapacitors derived from IS-0121's body fluids.
summary: Ramrod uses battery charge to cause a lightning effect upon hit that damages nearby enemies, even if the attack strikes a surface or object. It can still be used if it runs out of charge but will not cause the lightning effect.

name: Rat Scanner
description: An ornamented device built for scanning something in the environment that isn't immediately clear. Should make a decent whacking stick, though.
summary: Rat Scanner is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It is functionally identical to the Pipe Wrench as a weapon.

description: Ammo for a high-tech crossbow.

description: An assault shotgun, coated in black.
summary: Romag Shotgun is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

flavor: A high-tech way to fling a bunch of screws in something's face.
summary: Scrapshot FL is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

description: Your standard-issue firearm for facility security.
summary: Security Pistol is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Security Pistol FL
description: Your standard-issue firearm for facility security, with a flashlight duct taped to it.
summary: Security Pistol FL is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Seeker Quill
description: An Exor quill with a bit of homing science to spice things up.
summary: Seeker Quill is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Skink (Weapon)
description: A deadly biological cannon, with a very affable demeanour.
summary: Skink (Weapon) is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It fires globs of Radioactive Waste, which are capable of sticking to walls. The trigger can be pulled rapidly for smaller globs and held for larger globs.

name: Sledgehammer
description: An exceptionally heavy hammer for pounding things into the ground.
summary: Sledgehammer is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Slushie Bomb
description: Once an ice cold drink, now turned into an ice bomb of sorts. Can really put a chill on any encounter.
summary: Slushie Bomb is a throwable explosive in Abiotic Factor.

name: Snowball
description: Your typical ball of packed ice and snow.
flavor: Send it flying through the air with a hefty throw!
summary: The Snowball functions like a regular thrown weapon. Primary action quickly throws it, while secondary action aims your throw.

name: Snowfall Shotgun
description: A heavy shotgun, cryogenically refitted to fire ricocheting rounds that freeze enemies.
flavor: Dr. Stern doesn't often dabble in weaponry, but when he does, he always wraps it in a warm scarf of poetry. This concerns Dr. Ross.
summary: Snowfall Shotgun is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Stun Baton
description: An electrified baton that briefly immobilizes enemies.
flavor: Safety suggestion: Hold the boring end.
summary: Stun Baton is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It can stun enemies with electricity, temporarily preventing them from moving or attacking.

name: Sword
description: An edged, bladed weapon intended for cutting
summary: === Furniture Store === * Mounted on the wall over the fireplace on the first floor.

name: Talagi Magnum
description: A high-powered handcannon capable of neutralizing large foes and completely obliterating smaller ones.
flavor: A few shots from this should put down most things on Earth. However...
summary: Talagi Magnum is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Tech Sceptre
description: An electrically charged mace. Requires a charge to deal electrical damage and knock back enemies.
summary: Tech Sceptre is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Thermal Mallet
description: A sturdy hammer capable of leaving scorching fire at the location it hits.
summary: Thermal Mallet is a single-hand blunt weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Thermite Molotov
description: An explosive charge made from alien residue.
flavor: This will burn through just about anything.
summary: Thermite Molotov is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Thresher
description: A heavy-hitting carbon alloy blade launcher with a twin-tier accelerator.
summary: Thresher is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It fires Grinder Discs that are capable of bouncing off walls.

name: Throw Net
description: A throwable net, great for temporarily trapping small creatures, leaving them vulnerable. This net might even confuse a larger creature for a short while.
summary: Throw Net is a throwable weapon in Abiotic Factor. It disables small and medium enemies for a few seconds. Pests, when captured by a net, can be instantly killed with a stomp. Doing so will always make the Pest drop one Bio Scrap.

name: Throwing Crystal
description: A pellucid blade made from the knapped crystal remains of IS-0139, fragile but expertly balanced for throwing.
summary: Throwing Crystal is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Throwing Dart
description: A simple, throwable blade, but unlikely to survive the journey.
summary: Throwing Dart is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Throwing Quill
description: A throwable, acidic quill derived from IS-0184 and its kin. Not particularly durable, but particularly deadly.
summary: Throwing Quill is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Throwing Shard
description: A lethally sharp and strong blade of super-hardened ice.
summary: Throwing Shard is an item in Abiotic Factor.

name: Thumper Shotgun
description: A hefty shotgun that launches acidic, ricocheting rounds, with biometric locks removed.
summary: Thumper Shotgun is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Toaster SMG
description: A 9mm SMG augmented to coat rounds in a flammable gel that ignites targets, with biometric locks removed.
summary: Toaster SMG is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Toilet Plunger
description: It sort of speaks for itself.
summary: Toilet Plunger is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Umbrella
description: Portable protection from rain or sun
summary: Portable protection from rain or sun

description: Flings skink mucus to apply medical aid to allies from afar. Charged shots create larger healing clouds.
flavor: Turn deadly green slime into healthful green slime!
summary: Verdant Skink (Weapon) is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It fires globs of healing Radioactive Waste that explode into healing spores on contact with any surface. The trigger can be pulled rapidly for smaller globs and held for larger globs.

name: Verenkov's SMG
description: A heavily retooled SMG that ionizes projectiles for greater damage against bodyshields, with biometric locks removed.
flavor: Dr. Verenkov's experimental 'plasmification' technology was originally intended for rapid ignition of fuel pellets.
summary: Verenkov's SMG is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It deals Plasma damage that is especially effective against Hardlight shields.

name: Volt Staff
description: An augmented Exor staff that condenses and discharges bioelectric energy. Charges by striking foes.
flavor: Transmutes life energy into an electrical death force.
summary: Volt Staff is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It has a basic stab attack, and a secondary attack. When the left mouse button is pressed, the spear will stab similar to other spears. The weapon can be charged by stabbing enemies and fired with the right mouse button, firing a blast of energy.

name: Welding Spear
description: A superheated spear capable of dealing explosive fire damage to targets.
summary: Welding Spear is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Wessex Rifle
description: A high-powered, bolt-action, military-grade sniper rifle.
summary: Wessex Rifle is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Woodsman's Axe
description: A hefty axe for felling the strongest trees. Or foes.
flavor: There's a small hint of blood residue or perhaps it's simply sap. It's become difficult to tell.
summary: Woodsman's Axe is a weapon in Abiotic Factor.

name: Z-17
description: An exceptionally well-engineered and balanced semi-automatic sidearm with integrated suppressor, weighted for high velocity and low recoil.
flavor: The Z-17's design is intimately informed by ballistic lessons learned in the GATE Kinetics Division, and honors Dr. Halen Zizek, a projectile expert and Division founder whose lucky number was 17.
